result.instructions: Tools for GymMaster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many current members do we have, and how did that change this month?"; "Run the Current Members standard report for the last 30 days."; "Show the membership retention and new memberships for this year.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GymMaster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gymmaster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gymmaster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gymmaster_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gymmaster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_kpi_categories
tools.title: List KPI categories
tools.description: List the KPI category names (for example member_statistics, sales_made, class_summary). Use them with gymmaster_get_kpi_categories. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/kpi/categories/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_kpi_fields
tools.title: List KPI fields
tools.description: List the KPI field names (for example current_members, new_memberships, membership_retention). Use them with gymmaster_get_kpi_fields. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/kpi/fields/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories
tools.title: Get KPI categories
tools.description: Get the KPI values for one or more categories over a date range. Set grouped_categories to false for one flat list. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/kpi/categories.

grouped_categories.description: Group the values by category (default true).

company_id.description: Company (club site) id, for clubs with several companies.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_kpi_fields
tools.title: Get KPI fields
tools.description: Get individual KPI field values over a date range, for example current members or new memberships. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/kpi/fields.

company_id.description: Company (club site) id, for clubs with several companies.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_standard_reports
tools.title: List standard reports
tools.description: List the standard report ids and names (for example Current Members, All Bookings). Use an id with gymmaster_run_standard_report. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/standard_report/list.

predefined_only.description: Skip copies the user made of a report (default true).

tools.name: gymmaster_run_standard_report
tools.title: Run a standard report
tools.description: Run one standard report for a date range, the same data as Report and Till → Standard Report. Member reports can include member names. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/standard_report.

displaymode.description: For member reports: CURRENT (default), ALL, or HIDDEN (casual and hidden memberships).

required_columns.description: Column names to add to the report.

company_id.description: Company (club site) id, for clubs with several companies.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_dashboards
tools.title: List dashboard widgets
tools.description: List the dashboard widget endpoints (type kpi or graph) for gymmaster_get_dashboard. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/dashboard/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_dashboard
tools.title: Get a dashboard widget
tools.description: Get the figures for one dashboard widget. Without dates, GymMaster uses the current date. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/dashboard.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name from gymmaster_list_dashboards, for example kpi.member_new.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with GymMaster
prompts.description: What you can do with GymMaster here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_member_numbers_for_a_period
prompts.title: Check member numbers for a period
prompts.description: List the KPI field names. Then read the values of fields such as current members and new memberships for a date range.

prompts.name: read_whole_kpi_categories_over_a_date_range
prompts.title: Read whole KPI categories over a date range
prompts.description: List the KPI categories, such as member statistics or sales. Then read their values for a date range.

prompts.name: run_a_standard_report_for_a_date_range
prompts.title: Run a standard report for a date range
prompts.description: List the standard reports of the club, then run one for a date range. Some member reports include member names.

prompts.name: check_the_dashboard_figures_of_a_club
prompts.title: Check the dashboard figures of a club
prompts.description: List the dashboard widgets, then read the figures of one widget, such as the figures for new members.
